speak_hint_noscore: This browser can't give a score (Chrome recommended). You can still record and compare.
no_score: Recorded. Listen and compare with the model.
mic_denied: The microphone is blocked. Allow it in the browser (lock icon next to the address).
mic_busy: The microphone could not be opened. Another app may be using it, or it was unplugged. Tap 🎤 to choose another one.
mic_silent: No sound is coming in. Choose another microphone below.
mic_switched: That microphone was silent, so I switched to another one. Speak now.
score_5: Perfect! You sound just like the model.
score_2: Not quite yet. Listen to the model again, then try.
score_1: Let's try again slowly. Listen to the model first.
help_sp_1: ▶ Model — Listen first. Each tap on “Speed” plays it slower (0.9 · 0.75 · 0.6 · 0.5×).
help_sp_2: ● Speak — Tap and say it after the model (allow the microphone the first time). It stops by itself when you finish and shows your score.
help_sp_3: ▶ My voice — Hear what you just said. Silence before and after is skipped.
help_sp_4: Score — checks whether you said the letters right and your rhythm (length of sounds and pauses). 80+ ☆ pass · 95+ ★ perfect · letters 100 and full rhythm = 🎉 100 points!
help_sp_5: Compare — top: the model, bottom: your voice, drawn as sound shapes. Red letters were heard differently; the orange box is where the rhythm differs most. Tap a sound shape to play from there.
sr_none: I couldn't hear that clearly — please say it again.
sr_audio: Speech recognition couldn't use the microphone. Choose another microphone (🎤).
sr_network: An internet connection is needed for scoring.
sr_denied: Speech recognition is blocked. Allow the microphone in the browser.
kept_better: Your saved one scored higher — kept it.
del_all: Delete all my recordings in this episode
del_all_q: Delete all your recordings in this episode?
ep_missing: That lesson wasn't found — here is the list.
why_time: ⏱ Time's up — speak a little faster
subs_tip: Finished studying? Now listen to the original without subtitles. That is your real skill!
why_tail: The end wasn’t heard: {tail} — say it all the way through
why_other: It sounded like something else — listen to the model {say} and repeat it
why_many: {ws} and more are different — listen to the model and try again
cmp_none: Nothing to compare yet — record first.
rhy_speed: speed is very different from the model
help_sp_6: Save — Over 80, a “Save” button appears. It is replaced only by a higher score and stays only on this device (cleared if you delete the app’s data). “⬇ File” downloads it.
wx_missing: Stroke {n} ({j}) is missing — trace the orange dashes
wx_order: You drew stroke {n} before stroke {m} — see ✎ Order
wx_short: Stroke {n} ({j}) is too short — draw it to the end
wx_long: Stroke {n} ({j}) goes outside the grey — stop at the end
wx_tilt_h: Stroke {n} ({j}) is slanted — draw it straight across
wx_tilt_v: Stroke {n} ({j}) is slanted — draw it straight down
wx_bend: Stroke {n} ({j}) wobbles — follow the middle of the grey
wx_pos_up: The letter is too high — match the grey letter
wx_pos_down: The letter is too low — match the grey letter
wx_pos_left: The letter is too far left — match the grey letter
wx_pos_right: The letter is too far right — match the grey letter
wx_small: The letter is too small — write it as big as the grey one
wx_big: The letter is too big — stay inside the grey letter
wx_extra: There is an extra line — clear it and try again
wx_time: ⏱ Time's up — try writing a little faster
wx_line: Stroke {n} ({j}): the {w} drifts {d} {a} — stay on the grey centre line
wx_slow: Stroke {n} ({j}) was too slow ({s}s · usual {m}s) — one smooth move
wx_fast: Stroke {n} ({j}) was too fast ({s}s · usual {m}s) — slow down
wx_pause: Stroke {n} ({j}) stopped midway ({p}s) — draw it without stopping
wx_shake: Stroke {n} ({j}) is shaky — draw it in one smooth move

wx_g_how: Trace the grey lines in order
wx_g_magnet: 🧲 Draw near each grey stroke in number order — it snaps
wx_g_time: ⏱ Within {s}s · checked as soon as you finish
wx_g_jcursive: ㅈ·ㅊ: by hand you may join them like ス
h_dir_down: Draw this stroke top to bottom
h_dir_up: Draw this stroke bottom to top
h_dir_right: Draw this stroke left to right
h_dir_left: Draw this stroke right to left
h_dir_ccw: Start at the top, go counterclockwise
h_dir_cw: Start at the top, go clockwise
why_pause_tail: You paused too long — keep going a bit faster to the end
sr_only_note: letter score only on this phone
sr_only_why: This phone can't record and recognise speech at the same time, so only the letter score is given — no rhythm, compare or my voice.
sr_only_switched: This phone can't record and recognise speech together — from now on only speech recognition is used for the score. Please say it again.
sr_both_set: Next time recording and speech recognition will be tried together again.
why_late: Accurate, but much too slow — read along as the colour fills in
v9_lang_soon: Explanations in your language are coming soon — Korean only for now.
stt_server_note: Your voice is used only for scoring and is not stored on the server. A few recent recordings stay on this phone (for replay and diagnostics).
diag_keep: Diagnostic recordings on this phone (max 3 · never leave the phone · also deleted by 「Delete all」 in the list):
help_sp_7: {b} — Switches the app text to Korean. Your recording and sounds keep going. Tap again to come back to your language.
help_wr_1: ⌨ Keyboard / ✍ Handwriting — choose how to write.
help_wr_2: Letter row at the top — tap a letter to start from there. The colored letter is the one to write now; green ones are done. 🔊 reads this row; tapping a letter box reads just that letter.
help_wr_3: Keyboard — tap consonants and vowels in order. “Auto line” writes this row for you; “Auto all” writes to the end.
help_wr_4: Handwriting — with your finger or mouse, trace the middle line of the gray letter in order. Pick ✏️ pencil · 🖊 pen · 🖌 brush. Write before the time bar ends; when every stroke is drawn you get a score right away (or tap ✓ Check anytime).
help_wr_5: ✎ Order — shows the stroke order and direction. ↶ One stroke removes only the last stroke; Erase clears all. ▶ Next — go to the next letter anytime.
help_wr_6: 🧲 Magnet — draw near each gray stroke in number order and it snaps into place (no score, just learn the order). 👣 Follow — an orange dot goes first at the right order and speed; draw after it.
help_wr_7: Three scores — Shape (missing strokes, direction, order, length) · Line (how close to the middle line) · Speed. Shape over 80 and Line over 60 = pass · all three 95+ = ★ · Shape and Line 100 with Speed 95+ = 🎉 100 points!
help_wr_8: Box on the right — before writing: number of strokes and how to write; after: what went well (✓) and what to fix (❶❷), with the reason. Wrong strokes flash red, correct ones as orange dots. If the text is long, tap “⋯”.
music_hint: Korean folk songs played in the app. Listen or download them.
